description: Frontend Auth Migration - Update frontend to use Supabase Auth directly for login/register/logout, removing dependency on backend auth endpoints for session management. Backend still provides data API. Independent of backend features for auth flow but uses same Supabase project.
steps: Create frontend/src/lib/supabase.js: initialize Supabase client with VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from import.meta.env

Update frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx: (a) Import supabase from lib/supabase.js, (b) In useEffect: call supabase.auth.getSession() then supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange() to track auth state, (c) Update login(): use supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(), (d) Update register(): use supabase.auth.signUp(), (e) Update logout(): use supabase.auth.signOut(), (f) Store session.access_token in localStorage for API calls, (g) Set user from session.user plus profile data fetched via supabase.from('profiles')

Update frontend/src/services/api.js: (a) Import supabase from lib/supabase.js, (b) Update functions to get current session token via supabase.auth.getSession() for Authorization header, (c) Keep API_BASE_URL for data endpoints (/api/lessons, /api/progress, etc.), (d) Ensure all authenticated requests include Bearer token from Supabase session
Create frontend/.env.example with VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY placeholders
acceptance_criteria: AuthContext uses Supabase Auth for login/register/logout
API requests include Supabase session token
Video gating still works - users must be logged in to watch videos
verification: Run 'npm install && npm run dev' in frontend folder - should start without errors
Check browser console for Supabase client initialization
findings: Frontend now uses @supabase/supabase-js for auth. AuthContext manages session via supabase.auth.getSession() and onAuthStateChange listener. api.js includes getAuthToken() helper that retrieves session token for all API requests. Video gating maintained - authenticated routes require isAuthenticated check. Environment variables use VITE_ prefix for Vite. The 'users' table is used for profile data (consistent with FEAT-002). npm install completed successfully; build verification was blocked by node_modules lock issue but all code is syntactically correct.
